alt: 孩子曾被突然爆掉的氣球嚇到，現在看見另一個普通氣球靠近，就立刻緊張地縮起身子。
scene_prompt: 驚弓之鳥 means a previous fright makes someone react fearfully to a harmless reminder. Modern child at a calm small neighborhood party. Dominant scene: a perfectly intact ordinary balloon drifts gently toward the child, but the child flinches and covers ears, eyes anxious. A SMALL soft pencil memory bubble above shows the SAME child startled earlier by a balloon popping, with harmless pieces of balloon and tiny pencil burst strokes, no words. Nearby parent kneels reassuringly and other guests remain calm. Clear earlier fright versus harmless current reminder, not an actual threat, injury or mocking frightened child. No sharp objects or choking hazards near the child.
style_prompt: Create ONE original children's picture-book illustration for a Traditional Chinese idiom learning website. Landscape 3:2. Modern everyday setting when appropriate. NO text, letters, numerals, captions, titles, logos, watermarks or identifiable existing characters. Clear visual storytelling for elementary school readers and readable at mobile size. Hand-drawn delicate graphite pencil contours, soft translucent watercolor washes layered with colored-pencil grain and hatching on warm ivory textured paper.
